description: Compare one generation, or set monthly_project to budget for finished outputs and retries at regular subscription prices. Rank only current, comparable USD prices verified for U.S. customers. Other and unconfirmed markets appear in reference_prices with no rank. The currency argument converts the output amount.

billing.description: One generation defaults to all billing cycles, including active promotions. Monthly projects default to monthly billing at regular prices.

monthly_project.description: Return monthly estimates for a finished output target. A plan must cover all required generations to rank.

qty.description: Duration in seconds (for video/audio) or image count.

name: quote_cheapest_platform
